title: Online reactions to the 2017 'Unite the Right' rally in Charlottesville: Measuring polarization in Twitter networks using media followership
reasoning: The paper analyzes political polarization and the spread of messages by extremist groups on Twitter. While these topics may touch upon ethical considerations or moral stances of the groups involved, the paper's focus is on measuring network polarization and characterizing communities based on media preferences, not on evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics directly.
